extracted.name: Banana Bread
extracted.description: this recipe its just yummy something quick to do
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350°F.Grease bottom of the loaf pan; in a large bowl combine flour, baking powder,baking soda,cinnamin,salt,nutmeg and ginger; make a well in the center of the flour and set aside.
In a medium bowl combine eggs,bananas,sugar,butter and shortening; add egg mixture to flour mixture all at once, stir just until moistened (batter should be lumpy)
Spoon batter to pan; spread bake in the oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean
